name: MANCINELLA
key_symptoms: Continual choking sensation rising from stomach. Vomiting of ingesta, followed by gripping and copious stools. Burning pains and black vomit.
Vertigo; head feels lights, empty. Scalp itches. Hair falls out after acute sickness.
Icy coldness of hands and feet. Pain in thumb.
guiding_symptoms: Continual choking sensation rising from stomach. Vomiting of ingesta, followed by gripping and copious stools. Burning pains and black vomit.

mind_symptoms: Silent mood, sadness. Wandering thoughts. Sudden vanishing of thought. Bashful. Fear of becoming insane.
head_symptoms: Vertigo; head feels lights, empty. Scalp itches. Hair falls out after acute sickness.
gi_symptoms: Continual choking sensation rising from stomach. Vomiting of ingesta, followed by gripping and copious stools. Burning pains and black vomit.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Icy coldness of hands and feet. Pain in thumb.
skin_symptoms: Intense erythema. Vesicles. Fungoid growths. Erysipelas. Large blisters, as from scalds. Heavy, brown crusts and scabs. Pemphigus.
